home.title: LLM Performance Portal
home.subtitle: Professional LLM API performance benchmarking tool. Accurately captures sub-millisecond latency, simulates real-world workloads, and provides Silicon Valley-level expert diagnosis.
home.feature_1_desc: Supports major LLM API protocols including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, with easy custom interface extensions.
home.feature_2_desc: Sub-millisecond performance metrics: TTFT, TPS, ITL, TBT, QPS for comprehensive evaluation of model responsiveness and generation quality.
home.feature_3_desc: Automated diagnostics based on Silicon Valley performance engineering standards to identify Prefill bottlenecks, KV Cache overflows, and other issues.
